npcs.name: 拉胡琴的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man who plays the 胡琴 fiddle in the park
npcs.character: Gentle, a little sad that his friends talk through his music.

explains.对牛弹琴: 跟不想听的人说话，没有用。

npcs.name: 踢毽子的奶奶
npcs.role: an old woman kicking a 毽子 with friends
npcs.character: Nimble and bossy; wants everyone to play.
knows: She has kicked 毽子 here every morning for forty years

explains.毽子: 用脚踢的小东西，上面有毛。

npcs.name: 小朋友
npcs.role: a boy who loves the Echo Wall
npcs.character: Mischievous, whispers secrets into the wall.
knows: The qilin statue at 国子监 winks at dusk

explains.回音壁: 一个圆的墙，你在这边说话，那边能听见。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: So this is the Temple of Heaven!
nodes.why: 天坛 — where emperors prayed for good harvests. The round blue hall is 祈年殿; the Echo Wall 回音壁 is further east.

nodes.say: 谢谢！他们都不听，我是对牛弹琴！
nodes.translate: Thank you! They never listen — I'm playing the zither to cows!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 对牛弹琴 — playing the zither to a cow: talking to people who won't listen. He is joking about his chatting friends.

nodes.say: 我们在踢毽子。你也来吧！
nodes.translate: We're kicking the 毽子. Come and join in!

words.explain: 用脚踢的小东西，上面有毛。

nodes.say: 你好！你去那边，听！我在这儿说话。
nodes.translate: Hi! You go over there and listen! I'll talk from here.
nodes.why: The Echo Wall carries a whisper all the way round: go to the wall on the far side (the 墙 sign) and listen.

nodes.speaker: echo-boy
nodes.translate: The qilin… is at… the Imperial Academy…
nodes.why: Listen first: 🔁 plays it again, Show reveals the words. It is free.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: The Imperial Academy! Let's go there.

steps.now: 兔儿爷 has heard of a spirit that loves learning. Start at 天坛 — line 5 to 天坛东门.
At the Echo Wall 回音壁, east of the Hall of Prayer, a boy wants to whisper you a secret through the wall. Talk to him, then put your ear to the wall.
The whisper said 国子监. Ride line 5 north to 雍和宫 and walk along 国子监街 to the Academy's gate.
The bronze 麒麟 in the Academy's courtyard wakes at dusk. Come after five in the afternoon.

idioms.meaning: to talk to someone who cannot or will not understand

story.zh: 以前有一个人，他很会弹琴。有一天，他给一头牛弹琴。牛不听，还在吃草。
story.en: Once a man who played the zither beautifully played for a cow. The cow didn't listen; it went on eating grass.
